The climate in Kavala

Kavala is about 34 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 30°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 2°C. Around 780 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 111 mm). The highest temperature in Kavala in 2015–2024 was 38°C (18 July 2024) and the lowest −7°C (8 January 2017).

Best time to visit Kavala

The most pleasant weather in Kavala is usually in May, June, September and October: average highs are between 20°C and 27°C, with up to 9 days of rain a month. In August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
